description:
Rework apps/even-hub/src/ui/SettingsView.tsx around the resolver from the registry ticket.

- Services section (replaces ProviderSection): one generic key row per cloud service (Soniox, Speechmatics): saved/not-saved state, Save/Replace, Test (testSonioxKey; testSpeechmaticsKey once it exists), Remove. Removing a key that a selected option needs resets those roles to their local default with a toast (today's Remove does this for provider only). Short per-service privacy line.
- Models section (replaces "On-device models" heading): each ModelPicker lists local entries and cloud options in <optgroup>s "On this phone" / "Cloud". Disabled options show the resolver's reason (e.g. "Save a Speechmatics key", "Needs Speechmatics live captions or final transcript"). Locked roles render a disabled select showing "Provided by Soniox" with a one-line why.
- Selecting a cloud option for the first time asks for consent describing what leaves the phone (audio; for voice-id also voiceprints). Stored per service.
- A summary line above the pickers: "Everything stays on this phone" vs "Audio goes to Soniox while recording; voices matched on this phone" etc., derived from the resolved selection. Same string feeds LiveView idle text and RecordingView meta (replace provider === "soniox" checks there).
- Download selected / Measure / benchmark-selected-best only touch local, unlocked roles; changeLanguage fallback skips cloud options that support the language.
- services.ts startup fallback loop (roles unavailable on device) must leave cloud options alone.

Done when: switching live captions to Soniox locks speech detection and final transcript in the UI; removing the key unlocks them back to local defaults; existing settings screens tests/snapshots updated.
title: Settings: API key entries per service and per-role pickers with cloud options and locked roles
